notes:
I judged all 33 SD1 claims. 26 conform and 7 do not: SD1-001, 005, 054, 088, 129 and 138. I edited no tracked file and committed nothing. My one file is the probe script at /Users/miguel/.julia/dev/Redstone.jl/design/reports/20261124_doc_conformance/probes/SD1_v/probe.jl, run twice from W with --project=test.

What the probes showed:
- P1: an abstract entry beside a concrete co-consumer builds (SD1-005).
- P2: a bare contract's port has the face u or y (SD1-114, SD1-138).
- P3: the table holds 9 cells for 7 output ports plus 2 root inputs (SD1-129, SD1-152, SD1-164).
- P4: generic holding fails as UnknownPort at the holder's input_wires entry (SD1-048, SD1-058).
- P5: a primitive with only y_state builds (SD1-088).
- P6: an alphabetical-order scan of Appendix D (SD1-001).

SD1-001 is about the spec's own ordering, not code. I classed it as a defect with a doc-only reorder as the fix. The definite breaks are bare store/bare contract in D.2 and kind marker/descriptor/collect in D.9. The D.4 Δ-names and D.6 StopPolicy/stop word pairs depend on how Δ and spaces sort.

SD1-138 contradicts SD1-114 inside the glossary: the face entry still carries D-436's 'no face' after D-437 replaced it.

SD1-160 rests on inspector code outside W, so I checked only the claims-per-face basis in src/.
